data.action: 双手持剑凌空挥斩，周身金色源石剑阵万剑齐发从天而降
data.camera: cowboy shot, dynamic low angle, epic action
data.description: 【德克萨斯 · 剑雨降临万物肃杀】荒芜焦黑的源石战场中央，狂暴的气流激荡。德克萨斯拔剑出鞘，双眸中闪耀着璀璨的金芒。随着她的剑指挥下，虚空中数百柄璀璨的金色源石光剑如暴雨般轰然坠落，将敌阵瞬间贯穿封锁——「剑雨，肃清。」
data.lighting: 金色剑雨爆裂强光与夕阳血色天幕
data.location: 泰拉荒野源石感染重灾战场
data.promptProse: Texas draws her sword on a scorched Originium battlefield, amber eyes shining as hundreds of golden energy blades descend around the enemy formation. The dynamic low cowboy view brings her commanding sword hand forward, with blackened ground extending into the distance. Sword light catches her logistics jacket and casts crossing shadows beneath the blades; a blood-red sunset remains visible beyond the golden barrage.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 剑雨降临万物肃杀
